response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior full-stack engineer with broad experience across web, mobile, and systems programming, but he does not meet the core minimum qualifications for this role. He lacks the required 8 years of C++ experience (his C++ work is limited to a brief 2014-2015 stint plus a bachelor thesis project), and his career has been focused on product/web engineering (Node.js, TypeScript, Ember.js) rather than large-scale cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, or compute platform architecture. There is also no evidence of formal technical leadership or mentoring of cloud/DevOps engineers.
strengths: Deep, varied technical background across many languages and platforms (D, Node.js, TypeScript, Swift, C/C++)
Demonstrated some infrastructure/DevOps exposure (CI/CD, GitLab, Docker, Kubernetes deployment for GISCollective)
Strong community engagement, teaching, and workshop facilitation showing mentoring aptitude
concerns: C++ experience is minimal (~6 months at National Instruments) versus the required 8 years
No demonstrated experience with large-scale distributed systems, cloud compute platforms, or hardware/storage architecture at scale
No clear track record of formal technical leadership managing cross-team priorities, deadlines, and deliverables in an infrastructure/platform context

key_factors.factor: Lack of large-scale distributed systems/cloud platform experience
Strong general engineering versatility and mentoring/teaching background
